Body.Content: To improve the user experience of Azure Application Insights in the Azure preview portal, we've reduced the width of several key blades. The resource blades for the application types ASP.NET, Java, and Other are now the same width as other resource blades throughout the preview portal. This enables users to see more blades on a screen, enhances the experience when a blade is maximized, and improves the pinning experience for the paired timeline at the top of a blade. A possible side effect of this change is that some tiles may not show up on customized blades. If you are missing some of the tiles, the fix is to click the ellipsis (...) at the top of the blade and select Reset default layout.  After this step, the middle of the blade will be:

To improve the user experience of Azure Application Insights in the Azure preview portal, we've reduced the width of several key blades. The resource blades for the application types ASP.NET, Java, and Other are now the same width as other resource blades throughout the preview portal. This enables users to see more blades on a screen, enhances the experience when a blade is maximized, and improves the pinning experience for the paired timeline at the top of a blade.

A possible side effect of this change is that some tiles may not show up on customized blades. If you are missing some of the tiles, the fix is to click the ellipsis ( ... ) at the top of the blade and select Reset default layout . After this step, the middle of the blade will be:
